title: Utterly Tender Dutch Vegetable Casserole
description: A hearty, lacto-vegetarian Dutch casserole featuring tender vegetables and a hint of sesame seed oil, perfect for a cozy dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, toss the sliced carrots and halved brussels sprouts with 1 tablespoon of sesame seed oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic in the remaining 1 tablespoon of sesame seed oil until the onion is translucent
In a large bowl, combine the roasted vegetables, sautéed onion and garlic, and vegetable broth
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the vegetable mixture in the bottom of the dish
Sprinkle half of the shredded gruyere cheese over the vegetables
Repeat the layers, starting with the remaining vegetable mixture, then the remaining gruyere cheese, and finally the breadcrumbs
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through
